coupons.formHint: The customer types this code in their cart and the discount applies automatically before payment.
coupons.codeTip: The code you share with customers. Keep it short and easy to type (e.g. EID25). It is always stored in capitals, so it does not matter how the customer types it.
coupons.typeTip: Percentage: takes a share off the order (10% of 200 = 20). Fixed amount: takes that exact amount off, whatever the order is worth.
coupons.valueTip: The discount value. For a percentage enter the number without the % sign; for a fixed amount enter the sum in shekels.
coupons.minTotalTip: The smallest order the coupon works on. It protects you from a big discount on a tiny order and lifts your average order value. Leave empty to allow any order.
coupons.maxUsesTip: How many times the coupon can be used in total before it stops on its own. Leave empty for unlimited use.
coupons.expiresTip: The last day the coupon works. After that it stops automatically with no action from you. Leave empty to keep it running.
coupons.listHint: Every code you created and its status.
coupons.title: Discount coupons
coupons.hint: Create discount codes (% or fixed amount) that customers apply at checkout.
coupons.empty: No coupons yet. Create your first one to attract customers!

referrals.percentTip: The discount a new customer gets when ordering through a referral code. The higher it is, the stronger the incentive to share — and it comes out of that order’s profit. Set it in store settings.
referrals.offNotice: The programme is off: the discount is zero, so the "Share and earn" button never appears in your store and nobody can refer.
referrals.statsHint: What the programme has done for your store, in numbers.

analytics.profitTip: Revenue minus the purchase cost of the items and the delivery fee, on confirmed orders. It does not include general expenses (ads, rent, packaging) — those come with the expenses stage.
analytics.profitBasis: Calculated on {{done}} orders · {{missing}} orders excluded (an item has no cost price).
analytics.profitEstimated: {{count}} of them estimated (orders older than the cost field)
analytics.profitNoCost: You have not entered a cost price for any product yet — add it in the product form to start tracking profit.
analytics.metricsHint: Your numbers since the store opened — tap "?" next to any metric to see exactly what it counts.
analytics.revenueTip: Total value of confirmed orders (confirmed, shipped and delivered). New and cancelled orders are not counted.
analytics.confirmedTip: How many orders you confirmed and turned into real sales.
analytics.newOrdersTip: Orders that arrived and you have not confirmed yet — the first thing worth your attention today.
analytics.productsTip: How many products are currently published in your store.
analytics.insightsHint: Numbers that point to your next decision: how much a customer spends per order, how the month is going, and how many customers come back.
analytics.aovTip: Average order value = revenue ÷ confirmed orders. Raising it with a "spend a bit more for free shipping" offer is cheaper than winning a new customer.
analytics.thisMonthTip: This month’s revenue, with the figure beside it comparing to last month (▲ up · ▼ down).
analytics.repeatRateTip: The share of customers who ordered more than once. A higher rate means your product and service are worth coming back for.
analytics.convRateTip: How many visitors out of a hundred actually complete an order. Under 1% usually points to photos, pricing, or an unclear checkout.
analytics.last7Hint: Daily order count over the past week — shows which days your store is busiest.
analytics.topCitiesHint: Where your customers actually cluster — useful for ad targeting and delivery pricing.
analytics.topProductsHint: Best sellers by quantity — restock these first and feature them at the front of your store.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.hint: A quick look at your sales, orders and best-selling products.
analytics.funnelHint: Of your store visitors, how many started an order, completed it, and received it — shows where you lose customers before they buy.
analytics.abandonedHint: {{count}} abandoned cart(s) waiting — message them from the orders list to recover them.
analytics.courierMonthHint: Orders delivered this month (incl. delivery) — to reconcile the amounts each courier transfers to you.
analytics.empty: No orders yet — your stats will appear here once the first order arrives.

profileSection.nameTip: Your own name, not the store name. It appears in the dashboard greeting and account menu only; customers never see it.

profileSection.hint: Your personal details, photo and password.

security.changePasswordHint: Pick a strong password you do not use on any other site — this account holds your customers’ orders and details.
security.changeEmailHint: The new email becomes your login as soon as you save.
security.currentPasswordTip: We ask for it to confirm the account is yours — it protects you if someone left the device unlocked.
security.newPasswordTip: Longer is stronger: eight characters or more, mixing letters and numbers. Avoid your name, phone number or birth date.
security.newEmailTip: After saving, sign in with the new email. Make sure it is correct and that you can receive mail there.
security.title: Security

store.revertConfirm: This discards all unsaved changes and restores the last saved version. Continue?
store.slugShort: That link is short — three characters or more is easier to remember and less likely to clash.
store.whatsappInvalid: Check the number: country code then the number without a leading zero (e.g. +970590000000).
store.collectionIncomplete: This collection stays hidden in your store until both the title and the search term are filled in.
store.slidesCount: {{n}} of {{max}} slides — the order here is the order they appear in the slider.
store.bannerTitleTip: The large line in the middle of the slide. Keep it short and punchy — two or three words read best on a phone.
store.bannerSubtitleTip: A small line under the title that explains it or adds a detail (such as how long the offer runs). Leave it empty if the title says enough.
store.bannerBgTip: The slide background: "Default" shows an animated wine-toned backdrop, or pick your own colour, image or video. Images and video are dimmed slightly so the text stays readable.
store.bannerImageHint: A wide, high-resolution image (1920×1080 px). Avoid busy centres so the text stays clear.
store.bannerVideoHint: A short clip (5-15 seconds). It loops automatically and plays muted, so audio does not matter.
store.slideButtonTip: A button shown under the slide text. Leave the label empty to hide the button.
store.progressCount: You have completed {{done}} of {{total}} sections — each one makes your store more trustworthy.
store.progressDone: Excellent! Every section is complete — your store is ready ✨
store.unsaved: You have unsaved changes — press Save.
store.basicsHint: Your store identity: logo, name, link and description — the first thing customers see.
store.previewDesc: A short description of your store
store.logoHint: A clear square image (400×400 px or larger). A transparent PNG looks best.
store.nameTip: The name shown at the top of your store, on invoices and in WhatsApp messages. Keep it short and memorable.
store.urlTip: The address you share on Instagram and WhatsApp. Lowercase latin letters, numbers and dashes only — no spaces.
store.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Modest womenswear in premium fabrics — delivery to all cities.
store.descriptionTip: Two lines about what you sell and for whom. Shown on your store page and in Google results, so use words customers search for.
store.contactHint: How orders and questions reach you — WhatsApp is required to receive orders.
store.whatsappTip: The number that receives your orders. Use the international format with a country code, e.g. +970590000000, with no spaces or leading zeros.
store.phoneTip: A direct phone number shown on your store page (optional).
store.deliveryPhoneTip: The number of the courier you work with. Every order then shows a button that opens their WhatsApp with the order details ready to send.
store.handleTip: Username only — no @ and no link. If you paste a full link we clean it up automatically.
store.facebookTip: Your Facebook page link, e.g. facebook.com/mystore
store.flashPercentTip: The discount applied automatically to every product in your store while the offer runs. Zero disables it.
store.flashEndsTip: When the offer ends, in your device time. Customers see a countdown until then, and the discount stops automatically.
store.categoryImageHint: A square image for the category (600×600 px). Leave empty to keep the default icon.
store.collectionTitleTip: The name shown on the card in your store, e.g. "Eid looks" or "Winter picks".
store.collectionQueryTip: Tapping the card searches your store for this term. Use a word that appears in your product names, e.g. "evening dress".
store.collectionImageHint: A wide, eye-catching image (800×600 px) that fits the occasion.
store.marketingHint: Your promo messages: a scrolling top bar and a welcome popup for first-time visitors.
store.sizeChartCm: All measurements in centimetres. The faded numbers are the standard values used automatically if you leave a cell empty.
store.returnPolicyLabel: The policy text as customers read it
store.returnPolicyTip: State the return window and conditions (e.g. within 3 days, item unused) and who pays the shipping. Clarity here prevents disputes after the sale.
store.deliveryPaymentHint: A short note about delivery times and accepted payment methods — shown on your store page.
store.deliveryTip: How long delivery takes and which areas you cover. e.g. 2-4 business days to all cities.
store.paymentTip: The payment methods you accept. e.g. cash on delivery or bank transfer.
store.deliveryPlaceholder: e.g. Delivery within 2-4 business days to all cities.
store.paymentPlaceholder: e.g. Cash on delivery or bank transfer.
store.name: Store name
store.urlHint: Pick a memorable Latin handle (like your store name). The old link keeps working.
store.deliveryPhoneHint: A “Send to courier” button appears on each order, opening WhatsApp with the details ready.
store.bannersHint: You control every slide (including the first): its text and background (color/image/video), remove or add (up to 5). If you add none, a default slide with your store name is shown.
store.noBanners: No extra slides — the slider shows the fixed slide only.
store.zonesHint: Set the delivery price for each of the three regions — it applies automatically and instantly to all its cities and villages.
store.freeShippingHint: Orders above this amount get free delivery (0 = off).
store.referralHint: Discount a new customer gets when ordering via a referral link (0 = referral program off). A "Share & earn" button appears in your store when enabled.
store.loyaltyHint: Example: after every 5 orders, the 6th gets 10% off automatically — brings customers back (0 = off). Not combined with coupons or referrals.
store.flashHint: Turn on a discount across all your products for a limited time — a bold countdown shows on your store and the discount applies automatically at checkout. Perfect with paid ads: urgency lifts sales. Leave percent at zero or time empty to turn it off.
store.flashActive: Offer live ⚡ {{percent}}% off the whole store until the set time
store.flashOff: Offer is off — enter a percent and a future end time to activate it.
store.adsHint: Running Facebook/Instagram or TikTok ads for your products? Add your pixel IDs here and your store will automatically track visits, product views, add-to-carts and purchases — so you can measure your ads and reach the right customers.
store.fbPixelHint: From Facebook Ads Manager → Events Manager → pixel ID (digits).
store.tiktokPixelHint: From TikTok Ads Manager → Assets → Events → pixel ID.
store.gaIdHint: Measurement ID from GA4 settings (starts with G-).
store.sizeChartHint: Enter bust/waist/hips (cm) per size. Leave empty to use the standard chart automatically.
store.returnPolicyHint: Shown to shoppers on the product page to reassure them. Leave empty to use a default text.
store.announcementPlaceholder:
Free shipping on orders over ₪200 🎉
New collection just arrived ✨
10% off with code WELCOME
store.announcementHint: An elegant moving bar at the top of your store. Write each announcement on a separate line; they all show in sequence. Leave empty to hide.
store.announcementEnPlaceholder:
Free shipping over ₪200 🎉
New collection arrived ✨
10% off with code WELCOME
store.announcementEnHint: Shown in the bar when the language is switched to English. Leave empty to show the Arabic text in both languages.
store.welcomePlaceholder: e.g. 10% off your first order with code WELCOME10
store.welcomeHint: Shows once to a visitor on their first entry to your store. Leave empty to hide.
store.categoriesHint: Control all your store categories: change each category's photo and name, or hide any category that doesn't fit your store with the hide button. Leave the photo empty to use the default logo shown.
store.noCustomCategories: No extra categories yet. Add your own with names and photos.
store.settingsHint: Customize your store: logo, contact, slider, categories, delivery and more.
store.btnHrefHint: Put a full URL (https://...) to open an external site, or an internal path like /shop, /category/dress, or /store/store-name.
store.collectionsHint: “Shop by occasion” cards on your store page. Each is an image + keyword that opens your store search.
store.collectionsEmpty: No collections yet — add one to show on your store.
store.taglineTip: A short line shown under your store name on the first slide.
store.taglineHint: Leave empty to show the default line.

product.costTip: What the item cost you to buy. Customers never see it — we use it to work out your real profit on every order. Leave it empty if you do not know it, but orders containing an item without a cost will have no profit figure.
product.searchPlaceholder: Search by item name or category…
product.emptyCta: Tap here to add your first item.
product.name: Item name
product.colorHint: Type a color and press Enter (e.g. Black)
product.variantsHint: Add each color, then choose its available sizes and the quantity of each. The customer picks a color first, then sees the available sizes.
product.qtyRequired: Enter the quantity for every selected size (required) — otherwise the color won't be saved.
product.addColorPlaceholder: Type a color name (e.g. Black) and press ＋
product.colorImagesHint: Upload the product in this color — it shows the moment the customer picks the color, and swaps the card & gallery image automatically (up to 4).
product.videoHint: Paste a direct video link (mp4). Uploading a video file needs hosting — use a link for now.
product.stockHint: Leave empty for always available, or 0 for out of stock
product.sizeStockHint: Shows customers how many of each size remain · empty = available · 0 = sold out
product.saleEndsHint: Shows a countdown to customers; when it ends the original price returns automatically.
product.colorUnknown: Color not recognized — it will be saved by name without a color dot. Try a suggested name.
product.deleteMsg: Are you sure you want to delete this product? This cannot be undone.
product.empty: No products yet. Add your first one!
product.nameTip: What customers search for and what shows on the card and invoice. Be descriptive: “Black flared abaya” beats “Abaya 1”.
product.categoryTip: Decides where the product appears in your store and in filters. Custom categories can be added in store settings.
product.descriptionTip: Fabric, cut and fit — what stops the questions and reduces returns.
product.priceTip: What the customer actually pays. If you set an old price, this one shows as the discounted one.
product.oldPriceTip: The price before the discount — shown struck through next to the current price. Leave empty if there is no discount.
product.saleEndsTip: A countdown the customer sees. When it ends the original price returns automatically.
product.imageTip: The main image — the first thing customers see in the store and in search results. Pick the clearest.
product.galleryTip: Up to 5 extra images shown inside the product page. Different angles and fabric detail.
product.videoTip: A short clip showing the piece in motion. It builds a lot of trust for clothing.
product.stockTip: Total quantity. Leave empty for unlimited. It is deducted automatically when an order is confirmed.
product.variantsTip: For each colour you pick the available sizes, quantities and images. Customers pick colour, then size.
product.featuredTip: Shows in the storefront under “Featured” — use it for the pieces you want to sell first.
product.formHintNew: Fill this in and the piece appears in your store right away
product.oldPriceTooLow: The pre-discount price is lower than or equal to the current price — customers would see a struck-through price cheaper than what they pay.
product.variantTotalHint: This governs sales when colours exist, not the quantity field above.
product.variantsEmpty: No colours yet. Add one above, then pick its sizes and the quantity of each.

admin.newPasswordTip: Send it to the owner and ask her to change it as soon as she signs in.
admin.settingsLoggedTip: Password resets and code sends appear in the action log with your name and time — never the password itself.
admin.nlAudienceDesc: Everyone who signed up for your updates.
admin.nlPhonesTip: Phone numbers — the platform does not message them; export to use them yourself.
admin.slidesSectionDesc: The first thing a visitor sees. A clear image and a short title.
admin.annArTip: One line per message, shown in rotation at the top of the page.
admin.annEnTip: Shown to visitors browsing in English.
admin.lookbookImageTip: A full-look photo, then list the product numbers visible in it.
admin.suspendWhat: Suspension hides the store from visitors immediately and shows the reason to its owner. Nothing is deleted.
admin.suspendReasonPlaceholder: Reason — the store owner sees this
admin.fixWhat: A mistyped email means she can never receive a recovery code. Leave a field empty to keep it unchanged.
admin.collTitleTip: Shown over the image — like “Eid looks” or “For work”.
admin.collQTip: Tapping the card opens search results for this term. Use one that actually returns results.
admin.collImageTip: A mood image, not a product shot — the card sells the idea, not the piece.
admin.featuredLimit: Maximum 8 featured stores. Unfeature one first.
admin.platCatsDesc: The categories shown across the whole site and every store. These used to live in code.
admin.builtinCatsTip: Tap to hide a category from the site. Nothing is deleted — existing products stay linked to it, so restoring it brings them back.
admin.catKeyTip: Used in the category URL (/category/kaftan). Lowercase letters, digits and dashes only; do not change it once products are linked.
admin.catImageTip: Shown on the category card in the categories page.

finance.title: Profit & expenses
finance.hint: What came in, what you spent, and what is actually left this month.
finance.statementHint: From revenue down to net profit, line by line.
finance.netTip: What stays with you after product cost, delivery fees and all expenses of the month.
finance.revenueTip: Total of confirmed, shipped and delivered orders in this month.
finance.cogsTip: What you paid for the items sold — taken from each product’s cost field.
finance.deliveryTip: Shipping inside the order total — not your profit, so it is deducted.
finance.expensesTip: Everything you logged below: ads, packaging, rent, salaries and more.
finance.fixCosts: Add your product costs to complete the calculation →
finance.addHint: Every amount leaving your pocket for the store — log it so it shows here.
finance.categoryTip: Pick the closest one; it shows you where your money goes.
finance.spentAtTip: The expense counts inside the month of this date.
finance.needAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
finance.expensesHint: Everything you spent inside the selected month.
finance.noExpenses: No expenses logged for this month yet.
finance.deleteConfirm: This expense will be deleted and net profit recalculated:
finance.missingNote_one: 1 order is out of the profit figure — its items have no cost.
finance.missingNote_other: {{count}} orders are out of the profit figure — their items have no cost.
finance.estimatedNote_one: 1 order is estimated using today’s cost, not the cost at sale time.
finance.estimatedNote_other: {{count}} orders are estimated using today’s cost, not the cost at sale time.
finance.settleHint: Money the courier collected from customers that has not reached you yet.
finance.inTransitTip: Shipped but not delivered yet — nothing has been collected.
finance.atCourierTip: Delivered and paid, but the money is still held by the courier.
finance.collectedTip: What actually reached you from the couriers in the selected month.
finance.settleConfirm_one: Mark 1 order from {{courier}} as received — {{amount}} in total. Use this when the courier pays out in one transfer.
finance.settleConfirm_other: Mark {{count}} orders from {{courier}} as received — {{amount}} in total. Use this when the courier pays out in one transfer.
finance.marginTip: How much stays with you out of every 100 you sell. Truer than the absolute figure, which grows just because sales grew.
finance.trendTitle: Net profit — last 6 months (tap a bar to open that month)
finance.recurringTip: Expenses you logged last month that are not logged yet this month. Tapping fills the form — it does not save.
